data.narrative:
Alto Neuroscience, a public-stage biotech company founded by Amit Etkin, commands a current valuation of $1.04B following $253M in total capital raised. The valuation assessment draws from a peer universe of 5 same-sector, similar-valuation-tier comparables in Biotech & Health, spanning both private and public stages.

The peer-median method is the primary applicable triangulation approach. The five-company peer set—comprising Chai Discovery ($3.8B), New Limit ($3.1B), Recursion Pharmaceuticals ($1.6B), Freenome ($1.1B), and Eikon Therapeutics ($539M)—yields a median valuation of $1.6B. This range spans $539M to $3.8B. A public-comp anchoring approach using sector P/S multiples (5.5x median across 3 public tickers: RXRX, TEM, ONT.L) cannot be applied due to the absence of disclosed revenue figures.

The single-method triangulation supports a valuation range of $1.4B to $1.8B (median $1.6B), positioning Alto's current $1.04B valuation approximately 35% below peer-median levels. Key uncertainties include stage heterogeneity within the peer set—two comparables remain in Series C while others are public—and the absence of revenue multiples to cross-check against public market benchmarks. The narrow methodological foundation limits confidence in precision beyond the stated range.
